packing_reconstruction_method.stage: five_kernel_context.py:1283 immediately after tentatively appending the first episode, before items/paths and before final episode counters.
packing_reconstruction_method.reconstruction: Remove selected items/paths/episodes from retained packet; reset bm25.selected/paths.selected/episodes.selected and episodes.budget_omitted to their prepacking zero values; remove episodes.limit_omitted added after the loop. Cross-budget retained fixed bodies must be byte-identical after this reconstruction. Use the same variant 3200 retained sole episode as the candidate; collectors do not receive token_budget and report identical applicable candidate counts.
packing_reconstruction_method.limitations: Intermediate stage is reconstructed from saved outputs and code, not directly logged. Exact agreement of reconstructed 1800/3200 bases and actual manifest estimates is verified; no revised performance score is produced.

causal_account.not_missing_assessment: hybrid reports eligible=1, events_scanned=1, facts_scanned=6, rejected={}, budget_omitted=1. Its 3200 packet carries Event 3 and produces the same assessment action.
causal_account.packing_order: The episode is attempted before items/paths. New ordinary Fact bodies therefore did not consume budget first; hybrid items 4 and 2 are filled only after episode rejection.
causal_account.dominant_change_for_this_case: Hybrid fixed admission body is 346 characters larger than legacy, entirely in charged diagnostics: channels +50 and components +296. Heads, personal concept graph and guidance are unchanged. The six-observation episode is another 12 characters larger because anchor_fact_ids expands from [4,5] to [4,5,6,7,8,9].
causal_account.threshold: Legacy tentative base+episode is 1790 estimated units (actual finalized packet 1797). Hybrid tentative base+episode is 1902, exceeding 1800 by 102, so the atomic episode is removed and candidate loop stops.
causal_account.compact: The retained compact episode has one observation (Fact 4) rather than six, shrinking this episode from 2556 to 1212 characters while preserving Event 3 outcome/task/scope/time/source/limitations. Its tentative total is 1370 and actual finalized packet is 1768, so the action is retained.
causal_account.action_dependency: All compared packets have teaching_guidance=[]. Planning consumes the validated episode as practice_feedback and maps independent_success to independent_variant_or_reasoning_check. With hybrid episode absent, no such assessment action is emitted despite Fact 4 text being present.
causal_account.not_generalized: This proves a budget/atomic-packing mechanism for this selected case only. It does not establish that all source/BM25/hybrid regressions have the same cause, nor that removing diagnostics is a safe or sufficient production fix.

code_evidence.claim: Episode collection receives max_facts=1 for compact, otherwise policy.max_episode_facts.
Candidate channels and model/corpus/source diagnostics are assembled before budget admission and charged to the packet.
Fixed projection is trimmed only when it alone exceeds budget; episodes are atomic and failure breaks the newest-first loop.
Ordinary items are packed after the episode loop.
Final diagnostic counters are charged; any additional overflow can remove complete items or episodes.
Compact limits observation count but retains explicit episode conditions and source closure.
Only a delivered valid episode supplies episode-based practice feedback.
The practice feedback source yields the deterministic assessment action.
